Reason for Mistake: The Planner misunderstood the task. The problem required identifying the position held by the first Prime Minister of India before he became Prime Minister, which was "Governor-General of India." Instead, the Planner interpreted the task as asking for the position of the first Prime Minister of India during his tenure, leading to the conclusion that Jawaharlal Nehru held the position of "Prime Minister." This misunderstanding of the task requirements led to the incorrect solution.
